statement: For every k-element subset S of {0,...,n-1}, define score(S) = (sum_{i in S} nums1[i]) * (min_{i in S} nums2[i]). The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum of score(S) over all k-element subsets S of {0,...,n-1}; equivalently, score(S) <= r for every such S, and score(S) = r for at least one such S.
